about: The only file to edit when a new body GLB arrives. url is relative to public/. nodes maps each GLB node (or mesh) name to a render layer and a contract region. Several nodes may share a layer: they are merged. A layer with no node is simply not drawn. Anchors come from docs/body-map.json (metres, +y up, +z front, feet at y = 0); give a metric a new point under anchors if the new model differs. structureRanges is true only for the GLB that docs/body-map.json was measured on: its triangle ranges paint single structures. Set it to false for a new model and whole layers take the colour.
